industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Tera Light
summary: Tera Light Ltd engages in the construction, operation, and maintenance of photovoltaic systems in Israel. It engages in the provision of large ground-based photovoltaic installations; and construction, operation, and maintenance of small dual-use solar systems, such as solar systems installed on roofs and fences. The company also invests in renewable energy. Tera Light Ltd was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
